findingClass: pull-model verification check PULL-NOOP: writes per cycle ÷ fields re-asked per cycle
whatItAsks: real value/source changes (not re-read rewrites) ÷ fields re-asked per cycle; writes on IPOs with a document re-read or an OD-163 answers round in the window are exempt (#1490) NOTE: the exemption is IPO-wide for the 24h window (a real flip on an IPO that also had a re-read or answers round is not counted), and it relies on a re-read leaving previous_value NULL (unproven on real rows; staging had 0 real changes)
healthy: near zero on a day with no filings
alarmsWhen: rises without a matching document arrival — verification is rewriting unchanged values
scope: phase-1 IPOs, MAINBOARD + SME, prod + staging slots (docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §2.1)
consumerReason: brief-assigned: the ratio is defined per cycle (“writes per cycle ÷ fields re-asked per cycle”) and needs the cycle’s own write identities to explain a rise
status: built 2026-09-20 (item 10): record() call lands in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs; the 5% ceiling is a RECOMMENDATION per OD-18, to be replaced by a measured number once the check has weeks of output
